name: Stealth Assassin

steps: Press Play online. A message shows your room code; send it to your friend. For three or four players use Host a room for 3 or 4 players under Other ways to connect: the game starts once everyone has joined.
Your friends type the code in Join by code, or pick your room in the Rooms list.
The host clicks the title, then PLAY. On the mission menu the host clicks the PLAYERS button (bottom left) until it shows the number of players, then picks a mission.

keys.key: Arrows or W A S D

tips: The mission fails only when every assassin is dead. Each extra player adds one green target.
Everyone needs the same Ruffle Together build and game file; the launcher keeps them current.

description: Stealth Assassin (2014) as co-op for up to four assassins. Sneak past the guards, kill every green target (one extra per extra player), then reach the escape. Online play runs in Ruffle Together.
